name: add-stepper
title: Add stepper
description: An Add button that turns into minus, count and plus in the same footprint once something is in the cart, as in ordering apps.
docs: Controlled with value and onChange, or uncontrolled with defaultValue; zero means not in the cart. stockLimit and max disable plus and print the reason under the control, without taking room, so leave a line of space there; busy keeps the width and the focus while your cart updates. Minus at min removes the item. Always pass label: it is in every accessible name.
